_description: Supabase (PostgreSQL) public schema for Proximity, with what each table is for, who reads and writes it, keys and constraints, RPC functions, triggers, webhooks, the edge function, RLS and environment drift. Columns are "name:type" using Postgres udt_name (int4, int8, int2, numeric, bool, text, uuid, jsonb, date, timestamptz; a leading underscore means an array: _text = text[], _int4 = integer[]). Column order is the physical order on the dev DB.

_how_to_refresh: Hand-maintained; generate-knowledge.mjs does not touch this file. To refresh: query information_schema.columns (udt_name) on dev for columns, pg_constraint / pg_indexes for keys, pg_proc for functions, pg_trigger for triggers; compare against prod; then edit descriptions and statuses in place. Add a new table here in the same PR as its migration.
